title: Accept a daily employer project from the visible UI and start its risk-specific card battle

steps.description: Open the project page through the normal bottom navigation
Read the three authoritative daily contract offers

steps.name: daily-project-offers
steps.description: Capture low, medium and high risk employer offers
Accept the low-risk contract from the visible offer list
Start the card battle attached to the accepted contract
Allow queued end-of-week UI to finish its initial presentation before checking the real dismiss control
If the real weekly report interrupts this Sunday test, scroll its visible content to the actual close control
If the weekly report opened, dismiss it through its visible 收下，下周继续 control and verify the popup closes
Allow any queued message interruption to appear after the weekly report closes
If a real critical-message popup is queued, open it through its visible conversation choice and verify the modal closes
If a V2 workplace event interrupts the contract battle, resolve it through its real visible event choice
Acknowledge the real event result and verify its popup closes before proceeding to combat
Allow another queued workplace event to surface after acknowledging the previous modal
Resolve a second queued workplace event only through its real visible acknowledgement
Acknowledge the second real event result and verify the modal closes
Allow any third queued workplace event to surface
Resolve a third queued workplace event through its real UI control
Acknowledge the third real event result before proceeding
Confirm the visible start action activated the authoritative daily contract
The project contract must remain active after queued UI events are handled
Confirm the existing card-battle service started from the normal project UI action
The project UI must open a playable card battle
The accepted contract opens an actual card battle

steps.name: contract-card-battle
steps.description: Keep evidence of the visible contract battle
Restart the packaged game with the isolated scenario save

steps.name: contract-battle-resumed
steps.description: Verify the persisted active contract and linked card battle
